On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]], a group of former '''council members''' was set up alongside the planet's previous official [[Governor/Legends|governor]] as a provisional government after the [[Syndicat]] was overthrown. Elections were set for the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindians]] to elect a new governor a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later.
